title: Restore viewport clipping, zoom, pan, regen and stable coordinate transforms
objective: Restore deterministic CAD viewport/navigation behavior exposed by CAD-BENCH-RW-001 while preserving ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1, CADDocument authority and the canonical layer/selection semantics established by COMPAT-CAD-005.
acceptance_criteria: Geometry that intersects the viewport is rendered deterministically even when part of the geometry lies outside the viewport; clipping does not drop the visible in-bounds portion.
ZOOM and window-zoom produce deterministic view transforms and preserve stable screen/world coordinate mappings.
PAN produces deterministic view transforms without mutating CADDocument content, version or history.
REGEN/redraw recomputes viewport presentation without creating, deleting or rewriting canonical document entities.
All affected screen↔world transforms are shared and deterministic across Web and Electron, including rendering and picking paths.
COMPAT-CAD-005 layer identity, canonical selection, fixed-height command line and commit-authoritative command feedback remain unchanged and regression-green.
Golden workflows G1, G2 and G3 plus targeted navigation probes demonstrate real-scale geometry remains reachable, selectable and visually stable across viewport changes.
Deterministic automated tests prove navigation does not mutate canonical CADDocument content, version or history and Web/Electron semantics remain equivalent.
No frozen Architecture v1.1 boundary, Construction Graph authority or engine/adapter boundary is modified without an ACR.
non_goals: No ARRAY materialization/render/selectability; COMPAT-CAD-008 owns DEF-015.
No durable SAVE/OPEN/reload/session persistence; COMPAT-CAD-011 owns DEF-009/010.
No DXF import/export; COMPAT-CAD-012 owns DEF-011/012.
No layout/sheet viewport identity; COMPAT-CAD-013 owns DEF-018.
No new canonical store and no architecture modification.
risk_assumptions: The all-or-nothing endpoint rendering failure observed by CAD-BENCH-RW-001 is primarily a viewport clipping/transform problem and can be repaired without changing canonical geometry semantics.
The existing renderer/editor core is the correct shared implementation boundary for Web and Electron under Architecture v1.1 LOCK-017 and LOCK-018.
Navigation state belongs to the editor/view layer and must never become a competing project/document authority.
COMPAT-CAD-005 is the required canonical state baseline and must remain regression-green throughout this work.
ARRAY materialization and durable persistence are independent successor concerns and must not be opportunistically folded into this work item.

The view history for ZOOM Previous records COMMAND navigations only (zoom window/scale/extents, pan), max 10 entries — the AutoCAD-class previous-view stack depth. Wheel zoom and drag-pan deliberately do not push entries (a wheel gesture would flood the stack with per-tick states); this is disclosed, not a defect.

The fit transforms (ZOOMEXTENTS and ZOOM W) are UNCLAMPED by design — a real-scale site plan fits at whatever zoom the content needs (the shipped ZOOMEXTENTS presentation policy); the declared interactive limits govern the WHEEL zooms only, and the wide SCALE_ZOOM_LIMITS guards (1e-6..1e6) let command scale zooms honor the user factor exactly past the wheel floor.

The desktop host keeps its transient view policy (no drafting.setSettings view persist on navigation — the same presentation policy it shipped with); the Web host persists through the existing non-versioned drafting.setSettings { view } mechanism. Both hosts apply navigation through the ONE shared view module (identical math, LOCK-004/017/018).

The entity-step 'P' (previous selection) convention is explicitly preserved over the PAN command's P alias through the command-switch precedence (an entity/entityPoint step consumes P as the previous selection; PAN starts by full name or by P when no such step is running) — the shipped CHPROP/ERASE selection semantics, regression-pinned by test and the real-UI smoke.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated clipping, zoom, pan, regen and screen/world transform tests.
Negative tests proving navigation does not mutate CADDocument entities, version or history.
Web/Electron parity evidence for the shared view-transform contract.
Regression evidence for COMPAT-CAD-005 and earlier verified CAD/BIM baselines.
Exact-head CI and exact revision browser-agent evidence.
Real browser Golden G1/G2/G3 execution plus targeted off-viewport endpoint and zoom/pan probes.
Revision-bound evidence recorded before Architect review.

transitions.reason: COMPAT-CAD-005 is VERIFIED and the next dependency-ordered roadmap phase is sufficiently bounded to release.
Authorize z-ai-implementation-agent to implement the frozen COMPAT-CAD-006 scope and stop at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.

Begin the viewport/navigation slice from main a9867a8 (post-CC005 VERIFIED): the shared view-transform contract with deterministic partial clipping (the DEF-004 discipline), the ZOOM/PAN/REGEN vocabulary as view-only command plans, and the shared screen↔world transforms across every pick/render path on both hosts.

First navigation slice implemented and PR #139 opened at implementation head 6a93a71: the ONE shared view module (toScreen/toWorld exact inverses, Liang–Barsky partial clip, the pure navigation transforms, the declared zoom-limit vocabulary), ZOOM (window default + All/Extents/Previous/Scale), PAN (base+second / displacement), REGEN (ui+echo only — zero App API), the Web/Electron wiring through the identical functions, 34 deterministic tests + the 12-step real-UI Electron smoke + the web golden smoke.

Evidence package attached (EV-001/EV-002 + the PR evidence comments): 34 new deterministic tests (full suite 1426/1370/0 fail/56 skips), the 12/12 real-UI Electron navigation smoke, the web golden smoke + 11 regression smokes PASS, Web lint/typecheck/build clean, Electron typecheck + 7 real-UI smokes PASS, the real-browser G1/G2/G3 golden navigation flows with zero console errors, the negative no-mutation probes (elements/version byte-identical through every navigation; UNDO undoes the EDIT not the view). Stopping at VERIFYING per the governance gate — the Architect owns ARCHITECT_REVIEW/APPROVED/VERIFIED.

Independent Architect review completed against PR #139. The material implementation is unchanged after 6a93a71; c24fa8f is governance-only drift. Exact-head CI on c24fa8f is terminal (30/30 workflow runs, 88/88 check-runs), with one governance failure byte-identical to clean main a9867a8 and attributable to the pre-existing CAD-PARITY-020 dependencies defect. Exact implementation tests, Web/Electron parity, real-UI smokes and browser G1/G2/G3 evidence satisfy the acceptance contract; no Architecture v1.1 boundary or canonical authority changed.

DEC-003 authorizes merge. The approved material tree satisfies COMPAT-CAD-006, evidence is revision-bound to the implementation revision and remains valid because the only later PR delta is governance metadata; the pre-existing main-side governance red is explicitly not treated as a product failure. Formal GitHub APPROVE is unavailable because the connected identity is the PR author; the canonical governance decision is recorded here.

decisions.rationale: Architect review confirms PR #139 satisfies the COMPAT-CAD-006 first navigation slice acceptance contract: deterministic partial clipping, stable shared screen/world transforms, ZOOM/PAN/REGEN as view-only navigation, preserved COMPAT-CAD-005 semantics, Web/Electron parity, real-browser G1/G2/G3 evidence, and no mutation of canonical CADDocument content/version/history. The implementation tree is unchanged after 6a93a71; the later c24fa8f delta is governance-only. The pre-existing main-side governance failure is not a product defect. Merge authorized; post-merge verification remains a separate gate.
